dedupe_keys.name: generating large district heating system models from open data worked example for bottrop germany

description: This case study is the worked example in a December 2024 arXiv preprint from Forschungszentrum Jülich and RWTH Aachen on generating large district heating system models from open data and open tools. The authors note that detailed data on individual district heating systems, such as connected buildings and operational data, is usually not public, while some network structure data is offered by operators and general building information is available in OpenStreetMap. They combine these sources with software tools that estimate missing information, to build a digital representation of an existing system, and demonstrate it on the district heating system of Bottrop in North Rhine-Westphalia. The example analysis is a separation of the network into two systems, which needs the network structure, pipe diameters, heating plant locations and building information, and both resulting networks are simulated to check feasible operation. Access: the paper is open access under CC BY 4.0 on arXiv. Caveats: the model is estimated from public data, not validated against operator measurements on the pages read. It suits retrofit and transition studies of existing heat networks, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.

name: Generating large district heating system models from open data: worked example for Bottrop, Germany
outcomes: An exemplary workflow builds a simulation model of the existing Bottrop district heating system from public data (network structure and pipe data offered by operators, OpenStreetMap building information) plus calculation tools that estimate missing information, and uses it to analyse a separation of the network into two systems.
